graph.name: Record injuries and fatigue · Pre
graph.description:
Retain evidence-backed actor conditions so later behavior can account for them until recovery.

Lesson: Persist evidenced actor conditions across scenes; Recovery needs evidence, then Reflect adapts present behavior.

Limitations: This is model-proposed actor state, not medical simulation or authoritative health math. Full Post root Run writes memory and must use settled evidence.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Switch Capture to Recovery after settled treatment/rest; inspect proposed limits before full Run.
Change movement emphasis to climbing; compare hints while stored injury remains.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Settled condition: Rin twisted her left ankle in the previous scene. No recovery has been established.

Behavior brief: Keep the ankle condition in actor state and account for it in movement. Do not reset it simply because the scene changes.

Capture a condition: Analysis ≤1. Full Post Run writes locally without review; save may be unconfirmed.

Use the condition: Separate Pre Reflect Analysis ≤1; Behavior deterministic. Connections unbound.

Recovery limits: No medical math/seeded injury/scene-reset healing. Custom Curve needs nonbaseline initialization; absent curve starts at Baseline.

Stored limits for Rin (pre-state)
Purpose: Read stored movement limits.
Inspect: Check unresolved stored ankle condition.

What Rin is attempting now (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read current attempted movement.
Inspect: Check source IDs/omissions/actual action.

Movement with an injured ankle (pre-reflect)
Purpose: Appraise limits in this scene.
Inspect: Check movement possibilities/condition refs.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Render Rin’s behavior options (pre-express)
Purpose: Render behaviorHints unchanged.
Inspect: Check exact hint rendering; no model call. The same root Context and State snapshots feed Reflect and Express so scope, store version, source revisions and recalled evidence can be checked before rendering.

Condition-aware movement brief (pre-output)
Purpose: Expose movement guidance.
Inspect: Check brief; leave player choice open.

pre-reflect.title: Reflect · character
pre-reflect.instructions:
Use Rin’s stored ankle limit and present movement. Suggest support/less demanding routes as possibilities in behaviorHints. No invented severity, diagnosis, scene-reset healing or player decisions.

Return one raw JSON object, beginning with { and ending with }. No Markdown, fences or preface. Use at most two items in each reflection array and one concise sentence for brief.

pre-express.title: Express · behavior
pre-express.instructions: Movement options from the supplied assessment.
